symptom.failure: Managed native Git provisioning failed before Vulkan ABI compilation. Curl validation found an extensionless 345728-byte executable.

cause: Both native installer fallback URLs mapped every OS other than macOS/Linux to Linux. Registry metadata contains no Windows artifact for the observed Git, curl or zlib versions.

regression.before: Expected windows-arm64; actual linux-arm64. One failed test.
regression.after: 10/10 tests passed, including all eight supported OS/architecture pairs.

fix: One exhaustive native registry platform mapping now serves metadata selection and both global/project fallback URLs.
limits: No native Windows execution of the corrected CLI is established by the local parameterized test.
Correct platform selection does not create missing Windows Git artifacts or complete Craft Windows CI.
The original macOS cached Git PathAlreadyExists failure remains separately unresolved.
